 Home » Sports Abhishek’s Ton Powers India To 6-Wicket Win Over NZ in 3rd ODI
 Sports PTI 27 Oct 2026 3:49 PM IST 27 Oct 2026 3:49 PM IST India chased down 199 in just 13.2 overs
 x India's Abhishek Sharma celebrates after reaching his century (100 runs) during the 3rd T20I cricket match between New Zealand and India at the Hnry Stadium in Wellington on October 27, 2026. (Photo by AFP) As Preferred
Source Wellington: Abhishek Sharma smashed a 38-ball 113 as India beat New Zealand by six wickets to win the third T20 here on Tuesday, giving the visitors an unassailable 3-0 lead in the five-match series. Abhishek and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi (45 off 19) made mincemeat of New Zealand's bowling attack, hammering 133 for the first wicket in 7.1 overs. India chased down 199 in just 13.2 overs. New Zealand had made 198 for three after being put in to bat for the third game in a row. Daryl Mitchell top scored for the hosts with an unbeaten 89. Brief scores: New Zealand 198/3 in 20 overs (Daryl Mitchell 89 not out, Finn Allen 40; Arshdeep Singh 1/33, Axar Patel 1/36) lost to India 199/4 in 13.2 overs (Vaibhav Sooryavanshi 45, Abhishek Sharma 113; Kyle Jamieson 2/45) by six wickets.
